blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Discusses Finding the Best Commercial Lease for Your Business

One of the most important considerations for keeping your business on the path to profitability is finding the right commercial lease for your company. Not only must it be affordable; a commercial lease must never become an impediment to sound business. But how best to know beforehand whether your commercial lease is the right one for you?

A [Tampa CPA](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can provide all the research and analysis necessary to determine exactly what should be included in your commercial lease – and what should be negotiated. For example, would you accept a longer term (more years) for a lower payment? Or would a shorter term be more beneficial? Among the many items to consider within a commercial lease are:

items.text: Tenant responsibility for utilities, including phone, electricity, and water
Termination stipulations for the landlord and the tenant
